messages:
mira: Quick sync on dedicated ramp — vendor pushed H100 shipment to 2025-01-18, ~2 week slip. Likely ~10% capacity shortfall week of Jan 20. Need fast owner confirmations so we can decide fallbacks for reserved customers. Asks: 1) which reservations are hard (honor no matter what) vs soft, 2) canary window for new nodes, 3) power/cooling slack for db-rack-12. @jordan @kai @len please ack and add blockers.

jordan: Ack. Pulling rack power + inventory now. Quick note — if we reroute some batch jobs we can squeeze ~15% headroom on db-rack-12, but that’s manual for now. Will post spreadsheet link in a sec.

infra-bot: Created INFRA-5342 — "H100 shipment ETA slip + capacity mapping". Linked: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-5342. Power audit task added, ETA 1 business day. :white_check_mark:

kai: For canary I suggest a 3-node canary in us-west-2, 4h run with gating: p95 gen latency <120ms and error rate <0.5%. If we fail, auto-fallback to quantized-8bit variant and route traffic to smaller model pool. I can take Thu 09:00 PT slot.

len: SRE note — will prepare runbook and paging thresholds. Two quick Qs: are dedicated reservations hard-pinned (no evict), or do we allow emergency evict for system health? Also need list of owners for each reservation.

mira: Reservations marked "dedicated-enterprise" are hard — no evict. "soft-reserve" can be reclaimed with 24h notice. I’ll upload mapping CSV to the ticket now.

jordan: rack summary snippet (from audit):
```
rack: db-rack-12
power headroom: 15% (can re-route batch-c1 to rack-b to free another 8%)
GPUs present: 16 (8 H100 allocated, 8 spare)
expected usable after shipping: 24 (if new H100 install OK)
```
Spreadsheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/capacity/db-rack-12-inv

kai: Thu 09:00 PT works for me. I’ll create the canary job and add automatic rollback steps. Will also add a small smoke test: 200 concurrent short-chat requests for 10m.

mira: Nice. Action items: 1) @jordan finish power audit + update INFRA-5342 by EOD tomorrow, 2) @kai schedule canary Thu 09:00 PT and post runbook by Wed EOD, 3) @len prep paging runbook and ensure autoscaler honors "dedicated-enterprise" tags, 4) I’ll message sales + CS with soft/hard mapping by tomorrow noon. If anyone hits a blocker call it out here — otherwise we’ll run canary Thu and decide on short-term reservation reprioritization after results. :rocket:
